Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff and timeline

Hi Karthik —

Quick update from our side: our engineering lead just hit a blocker integrating the Redwood SDK with our SSO flow in staging. The stack trace points at token refresh behavior in the new 1.4 client. We attached a short log and a screenshot of the failing call.

This breaks the demo flow we planned for next week — engineers estimate a 3–5 business day fix to reach the demo milestone. Given that, would Redwood consider a short pilot extension (additional 7 calendar days) and a small sandbox top-up so our engineers can continue end-to-end testing without interruption?

We really want to keep momentum — the product team is ready to sign post-demo if we hit the new window. Appreciate any flexibility.

Thanks,
Anita Gomez
Head of Platform, Innovex
